characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, a bit naive and philosophical; calm, curious, humble when wrong.

characters.name: Verdow
characters.voice_notes: Senator Verdow: warm, jovial, laughs easily, internationally minded; the one senator Gladias trusts. Enthusiastic and encouraging.

characters.name: parliament office robot
characters.voice_notes: Drinks-service robot in Verdow's office; speaks one short Dzegoban phrase (Verdow set it to Dzegoban). Flat, polite synthetic voice.

characters.name: Belgor
characters.voice_notes: Graph Funding steward; friendly, enthusiastic technical explainer, speaks in long clear lecture-like passages, candid about tradeoffs.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, quick, warm but direct; in ch21 and ch23 she is furious and shouts (lines in capitals), in ch20 a determined investigator who wins people's trust.

characters.name: Zven
characters.voice_notes: Gladias and Seila's young son; energetic, excitable, proud of his Helisport and physics; calls Gladias 'Dad'.

characters.name: Hreda
characters.age: teen (school age, exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Daughter of co-family Vil and Daia; a math prodigy, bright, proud and precise; frightened but brave in her written messages from Northglade.

characters.name: Febric
characters.voice_notes: Son of co-family Vil and Daia; computer-science kid, calm and matter-of-fact, more laconic than Hreda.

notes: No exceptions: every letter has a single speaker in this chapter. NOTE Z here is Zven (Gladias's young son), not Zei - Zei is only mentioned. V is Senator Verdow (Vil is only mentioned). B is Belgor (Bai is only mentioned). 17:17 (robot) is spoken in Dzegoban. Device/ballot text at 17:7 and 17:119 is N-coded screen text, not speech. All attributions confident.
